name: fantasy-football-assistant
description: Live fantasy football draft assistant and season co-pilot for Sleeper, ESPN, and Yahoo

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix api install
scripts.build: npm --prefix api run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test -- --run && npm --prefix api run test -- --run
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix api run typecheck
